gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold states only that the patient presents with headache. The generated chief complaint adds descriptors (blinding, not resolving with usual medications) that are not in Gold. There is no simple statement of 'patient presents with headache' alone.

Gold: seeing lights in front of eyes during headache. Generated hpi-009 and ros-004: describe shooting lights and weird kind of vision. Lights are covered, but Gold also says vision is not disturbed (hpi-012), which conflicts with the generated description of visual disturbance.

Gold: worse when stands up, not when bending over/cough/sneeze. Standing aggravation and lack of aggravation by bending/coughing are captured, but added head-movement detail is not in Gold.
Gold: severity 5–8/10. Generated hpi-005 and hpi-006: 8/10 at maximum reducing to 5/10 with ibuprofen. Range is accurately represented.
Gold: ibuprofen eases slightly but not resolving. Generated hpi-006 and med-002: ibuprofen reduces pain to 5/10 but never fully resolves. Same clinical meaning.
Gold: patient was well before this episode. No generated fact states pre-morbid wellness.
Gold: lacking in energy but no weight loss. Generated ros-001: no weight loss; ros-002: mild lack of energy. Both elements are present, but they are placed under Review of Systems rather than HPI.

Gold: previous generalized headaches mild and associated with altered vision. Generated hpi-012: previous mild headaches relieved with ibuprofen and were NOT associated with visual symptoms. This is the direct opposite regarding visual association.

Gold: vision not disturbed during current episode. Generated hpi-009, ros-004, asm-001: describe visual disturbance (shooting lights, weird vision). This directly conflicts with Gold.

Gold: works from home. Generated sh-002: works from home and has missed work due to headache. 'Works from home' is covered; missing-work detail is extra.
